sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Sophie Casterwill took Lok Lambert and Dante Vale to stay in her townhouse after they fled from Dante's house in order to escape DeFoe, Grier, and the Suits. Lok and Dante continued to stay there for some time as Dante's house and Lok's dormitory were under surveillance by the Organization. [The Casterwill Client]

After Sophie's credit card was declined at the Marco Polo Airport, the team gathered at the Casterwill townhouse to find a way to conduct their mission in Egypt. Lok and Sophie decided to make money with part time jobs to be able to pay the plane tickets and give a salary to Dante. After repeated failures, Dante joined them at the townhouse and let them know he had gathered money with private detective gigs and had bought plane tickets for all of them. [All Work and No Pay]

Lok and Cherit were fencing in the townhouse's China room while Sophie was trying to master the spell Findshape. They ended up breaking a vase which enraged Sophie, and were promptly kicked out of the house. But the event suddenly allowed Sophie to master the spell, and she was able to repair both the broken vase and Eathon Lambert's journal. [The Unseen Guide]

The team retreated to the townhouse after being severely overpowered by The Professor, his elite Suits and his legendary titan Araknos while fighting on the roof of Dante's house. Dante created the diversion to allow them to flee and soon joined them, and while he appeared to be under mind control at first, he quickly reassured them. [The Secret of Two Generations]

LeBlanche gave a lecture on Italian painters to Sophie and Lok at the townhouse, as their school was still under surveillance by The Organization. The lecture was interrupted by Dante Vale to start planning their next mission to find Avalon. [Cave of the Casterwills]

The team headed back to the townhouse after Sophie successfully bonded with Phoenix, the legendary Titan of Immortality. Lok and Sophie then had a conversation on the balcony about Sophie's responsibilities as the new leader of the Casterwill family. [Cave of the Casterwills]

The Casterwill townhouse is where Sophie Casterwill, Santiago and LeBlanche live in Venice, Italy.

==Layout==
The townhouse features a tea room, several bedrooms, a balcony, a china room, and a study room.

== History ==
Sophie Casterwill took Lok Lambert and Dante Vale to stay in her townhouse after they fled from Dante's house in order to escape DeFoe, Grier, and the Suits. After repeated failures, Dante joined them at the townhouse and let them know he had gathered money with private detective gigs and had bought plane tickets for all of them. [All Work and No Pay]

Lok and Cherit were fencing in the townhouse's China room while Sophie was trying to master the spell Findshape. They ended up breaking a vase which enraged Sophie, and were promptly kicked out of the house. But the event suddenly allowed Sophie to master the spell, and she was able to repair both the broken vase and Eathon Lambert's journal. [The Unseen Guide]

The team retreated to the townhouse after being severely overpowered by The Professor, his elite Suits and his legendary titan Araknos while fighting on the roof of Dante's house. Dante created the diversion to allow them to flee and soon joined them, and while he appeared to be under mind control at first, he quickly reassured them. [The Secret of Two Generations]
